title: Let The Bible Speak
description: In this message, David Antwi examines the final days of Paul’s ministry in Rome, where the Apostle spent his days explaining and persuading listeners from the Scriptures. Discover why the strength of Christianity lies in its message, and how a deep understanding of the Word is the only true measure of spirituality.

title: Restoration: Return To God
description: What does it mean to truly "return" to God? Breaking down the prophetic words of Malachi, David Antwi challenges the idea that worship is merely a ceremony. Discover how to move past the symptoms of spiritual distance and find a restored relationship with the Father.

title: Pray Without Ceasing
description: True prayer isn't about doing nothing but praying; it's about doing nothing without prayer. In this teaching from the June Fast 2026 series, David Antwi distinguishes between prayer as an obligation and prayer as an invitation. Learn how to cultivate a rhythm of prayer that shifts the atmosphere of your life and repairs what the past has undone.

title: Keep Your Garments Pure
description: In this insightful sermon, David Antwi explores the biblical significance of the believer’s 'garment.' From the righteousness we receive in Christ to the righteous acts that define our rewards, learn how to protect your spiritual life from the defilement of the flesh and ensure your life reflects the purity of heaven.

title: The Presence of God
description: If you had one request for God, would you ask for a breakthrough or for His presence? Moses chose the latter, understanding that knowing God’s ways is more vital than merely witnessing His acts. This message explores how a purified heart unlocks a deeper level of divine guidance, turning God’s presence into the very map you need for the journey ahead.

title: Have a Pure Heart Towards God
description: Is your prayer life a ritual or a relationship? In this opening message of the June Fast series, David Antwi breaks down the difference between scheduled and triggered prayer, offering practical ways to stay spiritually sensitive. This teaching emphasizes the importance of maintaining a pure, child-like heart to ensure that your season of seeking God leads to genuine, lasting transformation.

title: A Special Message For Church Leaders
description: Explore the biblical blueprint for church leadership in this insightful study of Acts 20. David Antwi defines the vital roles of elders, overseers, and shepherds, explaining why the spiritual temperature of the pulpit determines the health of the pews.

title: What to Expect When Revival Comes - Part 2
description: When the Gospel takes root in a city, it doesn't just change hearts; it changes habits. This message examines the 'Great Exodus' of the early church—the moment believers valued their purity more than their possessions. Learn why modern revival requires a radical renouncing of the toxic influences and secret practices that hold us back.

title: It Takes The Oil
description: Every human being is a vessel designed to contain the divine, yet many remain empty. In this message, David Antwi examines the necessity of the 'oil'—the Holy Spirit—and how it transforms fragile, earthen vessels into instruments of honor and revival.

title: The Authentic Oil
description: Go beyond mere human effort to discover the indispensable anointing of the Holy Spirit, which empowers believers to do God's work on earth. Learn why Jesus is the ultimate 'Messiah' and how His poured-out Spirit brings healing, joy, and breaks yokes, while exposing the subtle compromises that can hinder its powerful manifestation.

title: Fresh Oil
description:
Explore the dual purpose of Jesus's coming – not just to redeem, but to baptize us with the Spirit. This message reveals why a continuous 'fresh oil' anointing is critical for every believer aspiring to be a usable vessel in God's hands.
description

title: Time to Transition
description: We are in a moment of rapid transition. Drawing from the book of Exodus, Pastor David Antwi explains why readiness is essential when God begins to move. Discover how to disconnect from the weights of your past and prepare for the 'Great Exodus' into your next season of victory.

title: Great Awakening
description: Are you active in church but passive in your relationship with God? In this sermon, David Antwi distinguishes between revival and awakening, challenging believers to move past the "sleep of death" and find true satisfaction by realigning with the mission, message, and image of Christ.

title: Things that must characterise your fasting
description: David Antwi explores how fasting serves as a spiritual catalyst for acceleration, turning years of delay into months of progress. This sermon breaks down the practical steps—from deep repentance to Bible saturation—required to ensure your fast is more than just a change in diet.

title: Attempting Great Things for God
description: Attempting great things for God requires more than just ambition—it requires a specific spiritual alignment. This message outlines five practical and spiritual pillars, including the importance of vision and the necessity of hard work, to help you prepare for a year of breakthrough and awakening.

title: The Implication Of The Virgin Birth | David Antwi
How To Love Your Wife| David Antwi| Ephesians 5:25-28
Let The Lydias Arise! | David Antwi | Acts 16:7-15
description: Discover the compelling story of Lydia, the first European convert, whose open heart to the preached word paved the way for the gospel's spread across a new continent, demonstrating God's desire to bless entire households.

title: The Foundation of the Gospel Part 2
description: Delve into the profound mystery of Jesus: the God of the universe who embraced humanity in its fullness, from vulnerable embryo to a man who experienced hunger, thirst, and death. Discover how His dual nature—fully divine and perfectly human—is the true basis of the gospel and the foundation of your salvation.

title: Once Darkness, but now Light|Ephesians 5:8-14
description: Have you been held captive by a past of compromise? This sermon powerfully proclaims that 'your best days are ahead' when you're in Christ, offering a path to shed past regrets and walk in renewed purpose.

title: Publicity Campaign for God
description: Discover how your salvation is more than a personal rescue; it's central to God's grand 'publicity campaign.' This message illuminates how believers become living displays, showcasing the 'exceeding riches of His grace and kindness' to the ages, demonstrating His power and love.

title: Things that Generate Testimonies Part 3
description: God is a God of covenant! David Antwi unpacks the profound truth of covenant connections, revealing how aligning yourself with God's work can activate blessings inherited through generations. Discover how to recognize God's activity and intentionally position yourself for His favor and breakthrough.

title: Your Prayers Matter
description: Time is of the essence! In this dynamic sermon, David Antwi urges us to make every moment count by seeking wisdom through prayer. Discover how to align with God's timing and unlock your potential.

title: Mercy Found Me
description: David Antwi's profound teaching unveils the often-overlooked role of mercy in our spiritual journey. This sermon illustrates how mercy transcends our shortcomings, opening doors and exalting us in ways we never imagined.

title: The Person of Jesus - The humanity of Christ Part 2
description: Explore the dual nature of Jesus Christ as both God and man with David Antwi in this insightful sermon. Unpack the complexities of the hypostatic union and discover the profound implications for your faith.

title: Put Off The Old Man
description: Struggling to overcome stubborn habits or past failures? David Antwi delivers a compelling sermon on the 'good fight of faith,' revealing how immersing yourself in scripture and aligning with a strong Christian community provides the very life-support needed to shed the 'old man' and thrive in Christ. Discover the practical pathway to enduring purity and freedom.

title: Learn Christ
description: Do you find yourself living like the world, even though you're in Christ? David Antwi challenges believers to move beyond surface-level Christianity and embrace a Christ-centered life. This sermon on Ephesians reveals how to cultivate a spiritual mindset, trace Christ's example, and experience true transformation from the inside out.

title: The Person of Jesus - The humanity of Christ Part 1
description: In a world of conflicting beliefs, discover the bedrock of Christian faith. David Antwi's message on the person of Jesus clarifies the vital importance of believing in Jesus as both the Son of God and a true human being for salvation and a life aligned with God's purpose.

title: The Person of Jesus-The Deity of Christ Part 4
description: Explore the dual nature of Jesus Christ as both fully God and fully man. David Antwi dives deep into scripture to uncover the evidence of His divinity and humanity, and how understanding this truth shapes our Christian faith.

title: The Person of Jesus-The Deity of Christ Part 3
description: Is Jesus truly God? Explore compelling biblical evidence and challenge your understanding of Christ's divinity with David Antwi's insightful sermon. Separate fact from feeling and build your faith on solid, irrefutable truths. #Podcast

title: The Person of Jesus-The Deity of Christ Part 2
description: Who is Jesus to you? David Antwi challenges us to move beyond second-hand knowledge and discover the Jesus of Scripture. Explore the deity of Christ and deepen your personal relationship with Him in this transformative sermon. #Podcast

title: The Person of Jesus-The Deity of Christ Part 1
description: Unravel the mystery of Jesus: human yet divine. David Antwi illuminates the unique attributes of Christ—omnipotence, omniscience, omnipresence, and eternality—demonstrating why Jesus is not just a prophet, but God manifested in the flesh. #Podcast

Agōnizomai 2: The Advanced Settings Of The Church
description: Salvation is a gift, but when you get to heaven, there is an another gift given based on your works. Being an amazing Christian has a lot to do with your service in the Lord, not just how nice and moral you are. Work to build the House of God.

title: The Eternal Plan of God Part 4
OIKONOMIA: Stewardship Of Grace
description: The quality of a believer has everything to do with how well they serve the Church: the body of Christ. The stewardship of God is given to a person for God's chosen people, for the pursuing and building of a church.

title: For The Sake Of The Church
description: True and genuine ministry is a function of the spirit. If you do it outside of the spirits, it is religion. Whatever you do for the sake of the church must give life because it is from the spirit.

title: The Heavenly Priesthood
description: #podcast

title: Made By Christ, For Christ
description: Everything physical you see bears the tag 'Made by Christ'. The essence of being a Christian is keeping Christ before all things. Whatever you're pursuing in life, do it in Christ.

title: Qualified
description: When you look at your history, you qualify for God's wrath, judgement and punishment. He has enabled (qualified) us to partake in their inheritance. Once you are in Christ, you have a share in the inheritance of the saints.

title: Dynamoō: “Strengthened”
description: Strength plays a role in serving God. This kind of strength is not just generated, it's given. Being strengthened means to be made dynamic on the inside. You may be going through a difficult time but be strong and remember, God gives strength.

title: 12 Prayer Points For God's People
description: Church is not just a group of people gathering, it is the body of Christ, the presence of Christ here on the earth. People classified as members of the body of Christ are very special people to God. Colossians 1 shows us 12 topics believers should pray. As we pray, these topics become our inheritance

title: Filled With The Knowledge Of His Will
description: Understanding is of the mind, wisdom is of the spirit. The wisdom of God helps you to understand and appreciate the will of God. When you walk in the knowledge of His will, you become fruitful in every good work.

title: Epaphras 3: Qualities Of A Faithful Servant
description: Epaphras was a faithful servant. Our commitment to God makes Him do some things we haven't prayed about If you want a sure investment, invest in the things of God

title: How To Live By Faith
description: Faith is a non-negotiable means if you want to enjoy God in your life. You can't walk by faith and be a cheap victim in life. Don't die in your condition when you can walk by faith.

title: Apostle's Creed - The Resurrection Of The Body
The Will of God
description: The will of God is paramount to the move of God. Every move is based on His will. The will of God has a lot to do with the plan of God on earth. When God has an agenda with your life, don't think the benefit is just for yourself.

title: Epaphras 2
description: The will of God is paramount to the move of God. Every move is based on His will. The will of God has a lot to do with the plan of God on earth. When God has an agenda with your life, don't think the benefit is just for yourself.

title: Epaphras 1: A Fellow Servant
description: Epaphras was a faithful minister of Christ. When you get near such a person, you will relate with Christ as they put Christ first. Learn from and associate with people like Epaphras.

title: The Effects Of The True Gospel
description: If you are a Christian, there will always be a hope in you that is different to others. You must have a reason to defend this hope. Expose yourself to the true Gospel and it will make you a better person.

title: The Word of the Truth of the Gospel
description: The only means to being saved is believing in the cross of Christ. God has not entrusted the message of salvation in the realm of research and intellect, but in the realm of preaching. If you stop preaching the gospel, you switch off the power to save.

title: The Christian Hope
description:
"You can't thrive as a Christian without hope. 
Christian life is heavy in love and faith, and heavily dependent on hope. Knowing the hope of His calling will determine the quality of your Christianity life."

title: Jesus Christ Truly God and Truly Man
description: You can't do anything for God without the Holy Spirit. While Jesus was on earth, He did all of these miracles as man who had been empowered by the Holy Spirit. As believers, desire for more of the Holy Spirit.

title: How To Live An Effective Life For God
description: How To Live An Effective Life For God

title: Christ Alone
description: Religion is man's way of getting to God. Christianity is God's way of getting to man. You are not growing as a Christian if you are not growing in the knowledge of Christ through the scriptures.

title: The Duty And Benefits Of Praise
description: The world does not know that we are a chosen, peculiar people. The doctrine of election comes with the duty of praise. None of us did anything for God to choose us. When you want to see God work, praise Him

title: Soul Winning- Loose The Tied Donkey
description: Soul Winning- Loose The Tied Donkey

title: How To Provoke Grace 2
description: How To Provoke Grace 2

title: God’s Patience Is Salvation
description: Believing brings you into salvation, reconciliation, justification and regeneration. We are saved and being saved, but our compromised state can disqualify us from receiving the reward of God. It is our job to be diligent so we are found without spot when Christ comes back.

title: Live With The End In Mind
description: There is a day coming, and if you keep that day in view, it will influence the way you live. Without the coming of Christ in view, your holiness will always be compromised. Live your life with the coming of Christ in mind..

title: Provoking Divine Encounters Part 3
description: Provoking Divine Encounters Part 3

title: The Mystery Of Honour - How To Honour
description: Honour is so vital to wellbeing and life in itself.  Well-being in life has been attached to the principle of honour. Learning how to honour -will help you to break through in life.

title: The Mystery Of Honour
description: Honour is like a hidden secret. Even if dishonour is hurting you, you are likely not to know. Your wellbeing has a lot to do with how well you honour key figures and principles in life.

title: Your Preaching Must Have A Reason
description: Your Preaching Must Have A Reason

title: The Session Of Christ
description: The Session Of Christ

title: How To Secure Your Destiny Part 2
description: How To Secure Your Destiny Part 2

title: Righteousness Matters, So Watch What You See And Hear
description: Righteousness and godliness matters; there is a way to live. The authenticity and purity of your righteousness is at the mercy of what you are seeing and hearing. Righteousness defends, guards, protects and directs. Don't be worried about the security of your future if you are on the path of righteousness.

title: Peace Through Faith And Love
description: Peace Through Faith And Love

title: The Reality Of Faith
description: The Reality Of Faith

title: God Is Doing A New Thing
description: God Is Doing A New Thing

title: Be A Sacrifice!
description: Be A Sacrifice!

title: Benefits Of The Spiritual Gathering
description: Benefits Of The Spiritual Gathering

title: The Blessing Of Jacob
description: The Blessing Of Jacob

title: The Power Of The True Knowledge Of God
description: As soon as you give your life to Christ, you receive power (the Holy Spirit). This divine power has given every believer what it takes to live a godly life through the knowledge of God (Epiginosko). Despite what is going on in the world, if you are a believer, you can escape the corruption that comes to the world through lust because of the divine power inside of you.

title: Sleep Not, Keep Praying
description: The Bible says that whilst Jesus prayed, the heavens were opened. Whatever you do as a believer, it should be done in prayer, because this is how you provoke a response from heaven. Although it may seem difficult to be able to continue in prayer, you must push past your physical limits. You may feel tired or weary, but sleep not and keep on praying.

title: The Gospel Of Salvation
description: The gospel in Matthew, Mark, Luke and John is about Jesus living amongst us. The gospel In Romans is about Jesus living in You. Here, redemption opens another chapter in our lives; a plan for a better life in Jesus Christ.

title: What You Say Matters
description: What God can do in our lives is under the influence of what we say, and even our response to declarations. When a declaration is made in the name of Jesus, it carries the power to change our circumstances. Until we receive this word, and it in turn enters us, there is nothing God can do in our lives.

title: Desire God, Drop The Weight!
description: It is a big privilege to be a part of a move of a God within a people or nation.  In this season, some are going to be used by God, whilst others may miss the opportunity. It is very easy for God to include you, but for this to happen you must desire God and drop the weight. Everyone has a weight, something that always seems to have a hold on them, but you must lay that weight aside in your pursuit of God.

title: Life in Christ
description: When you become born again, you are introduced into eternal life. The life that Christ has is not a life that can die. The only way life and immortality can be manifested is through the preaching of the gospel. When the gospel is preached, new life is breathed into you.

title: The Kiss of Life - Breathe
description: The Holy Spirit is the breath of God. The breath of God is what keeps us alive and forms the spirit of man. Without the Spirit, you cannot contact God and you cannot be used by God. You need the breath of God to walk in the spirit and fulfil the plan of God for your life.

title: SILVANUS, Making A Difference In Church Work
description: Faithfulness is a crucial quality of anyone God can take far and use in the His work. Every church, move of God and anointed leader needs faithful members around them. Like Peter, Mark and Silvanus in the scriptures, be faithful and build to the glory of God.

title: Engage Your Faith
description: Faith is a master key to dominate in every aspect of life. Our faith requires us to take steps and movements based on God’s word. In order to live our entire lives in faith, we must be weary of the enemy attacks against it.

title: The Power of Communion
description: One of the things that can bring a radical turnaround is the power of the communion, the power of the blood. Communion always comes to start something new.  The communion has the power to deal with weaknesses and sicknesses around us. As you eat the communion, you evoke the power of the blood.

title: How To Live a Life Of Sacrifice
description: Every anointed blessing comes with the ability to obey. To sacrifice for God, you must learn to depend on the Holy Spirit. The Holy Spirit comes on you to help you to do what you need to for your destiny in God.

title: Your Day of Visitation: Openness of Heart
description: To receive a visitation, you have to pay a certain price. If you want a visitation, ask yourself what kind of price you’re willing to pay. In your hour of visitation, do as the occasion demands. Pay a price to walk with God

title: Get Understanding
description: It is dangerous to have a closed understanding, in all areas of your life. You will not able to build, do well in ministry, or walk with God - a lack of understanding is costly. Doing well lies at the mercy of how much understanding you have. The Bible tells us that it is only when you have understanding that your light shall break forth, so if there is something you should pray for, it is wisdom and understanding.

title: Keep The Commandments Of God
description: We are a chosen generation, a unique people born of God, meaning that although we may be in the world we are not of the world and its systems. The Bible tells us that because we are born of God we are able to overcome the world by our faith. Faith is directly linked to loving and obeying God - even the worldly things that may make obedience to God difficult, we are able to overcome. Faith is a love exercise that allows us to keep the commandments of God.

title: The Saving Power Of Baptism
description: Baptism does not equal salvation; it is a symbol that you are a believer. Baptism goes hand in hand with repentance and shows that you identify with the burial, death and resurrection of Christ. Baptism is not there to remove the filth of the flesh, but, for us to be baptised into an excellent way of life.

title: Christians Are Strange People
description: Love is a debt that you owe other Christians. The Bible didn’t call us to be loved, it called us to love. The fact that you are a believer means you owe others love; you must pay it. There is a certain behaviour we should have among ourselves that reflects Christ.  The Christian life is a life that normal people can’t live. To truly live for God in this way, it will take the Holy Spirit.

title: Significance of the Cross
description: Every believer must understand the significance of the Cross. The Cross is where Christ died, gave Himself as a ransom and an offering, substituted our place and satisfied the the wrath of God. On the Cross, Christ purchased the Church with His blood.

title: Who Are These Women
description: Mary and Elizabeth are two very unique women in the Bible. Mary at the time was a virgin and so it was impossible for her to carry a child. Despite this, she had Jesus. Elizabeth at the time was too old to bear a child. Despite this, she had John. Who are these women? These two women that availed and separated themselves for God, thus changing lives.

title: The Rainbow Community
description: God’s plan is that you should bring Him glory in all that we do. This means that you can’t be a believer and not live for the glory of God because you will be living below the standard of His goodness. Christ came to bring the rainbow community. The rainbow community are the people who are going allow God’s name to be glorified here on Earth.

title: Faith Like A Mustard Seed
description: A mustard seed is so small, it can easily get lost, be blown by the way and be discredited or lost. It’s size may make you think it can’t produce a certain type of result. There are times where you feel discouraged but remember, when you have faith like a mustard seed, life obeys you.

title: Beauty Product Of The Fashionable Woman
description: Beauty is vain, it passes. Your beauty product should not be just the things you wear and what we see about you. There must be an inner beauty; a certain beauty product that emanates from your spirit. The beauty product of a fashionable woman is inside of you; Christ.

title: The Purpose of Prayer
description: The Purpose of Prayer

title: Healing Is Mine
description: God works heavily with your expectations; it’s your expectation that sets the platform for the manifestation of God’s power in your life. If you want divine intervention, you must have faith and be expectant that it is coming. Healing is yours when you are born again, it is part of your covenant relationship with God. You must declare that healing and good health is yours. When you are expectant, your expectation will not be cut off.

title: Christ Our Bishop
description: The Greek root word for bishop is the same as the Greek root word for visitation. The job of a bishop is to visit the people, looking out to promote them. As a Bishop, Christ is working in you and observing you for your day of visitation; the time and period in which God comes to bestow His favour upon you and elevate you.

title: Its On God
description: Its On God

title: It's All About The Word Of God
description: We are saved by the Word of God that we hear; the Word alone carries the power and potency to change the heart. For this reason, we must always consider what the Scriptures have said. Nothing changes the heart like the Word of God. Any faith outside of the Word of God is not genuine faith. You must learn to focus your mind on what God’s word has said because God’s word has the final verdict.

title: With God, It's Mercy Not Merit
description: As believers, we must always approach God asking for mercy in prayer, on a constant basis. God hears our cries for mercy, and he gives us what we do not deserve. However, we know when God responds to us, it is purely based on his mercy alone, and not our own merits. God’s mercy reaches out to us in our messy state and gives us a clean slate standing in the way of our judgement.

title: Progressive Salvation (Salvation Is Also A Process)
description: The salvation of your soul takes an entire lifetime. Progressive salvation is the salvation of your soul; you are being made free from the power of the indwelling sin. When we take up our cross and deny our souls, it makes the indwelling sin lose strength over us.

title: Thank God I'm Born Again
description: God is the instrumental cause of our salvation. He is the mastermind behind us being born-again. If you are born again, grace was allocated to you before the world began. When Jesus comes, grace comes. Anyone who has Jesus in their life receives grace. You can only do the things of God by grace.

title: Accessing Divine Healing
description: Accessing Divine Healing

title: The God Factor
description:
We must look for the God factor in every area of our lives, this means that God must be the builder, maker and foundation; of the important areas of our lives. In everything we encounter, from relationships to any personal pursuits, there must be a God factor within it. 
To do this, we must make a shift from focusing on how we feel, to walking by faith and see what God is impressing on us. Building our lives on a Godly foundation is an essential part of this. We must make the choice to walk by faith. When we do this, we put our confidence in God and move away from fear

title: How To Study The Bible - Part 3
description: How To Study The Bible - Part 3

title: Becoming A Full - Grown Christian Pt 1- Believers Reconciliation
description: You cannot be a part of the church if you have not been justified by God, reconciled to God and redeemed. Once you are redeemed, you must grow spiritually. Spiritual growth has everything to do with your ability to walk in the spirit. Don’t be carnal. Don’t be fleshy. Be spiritual and be a full born Christian in Christ.

title: Who Is Jesus?
description: Everything in Christianity is hinged on the single understanding and revelation of Christ. The mystery of Christianity is not necessarily in its teachings but the mystery of Christ; God captured in humanity. You have to believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of the Living God. You can’t be a Christian and believe in a Jesus that the scriptures didn’t give to us. Who is Jesus to you?

title: Living The Church Life Part 1
description: There is a difference between a church goer and a Christian. Every genuine Christian has an attraction to God's word! When you become born again, you become a default member of the body of Christ, which is the universal church. As a Christian, you must belong somewhere, at a local church in the body of Christ. The life of Christ in us is what we called the church life and it is a cooperate life.

title: Freed, Yet Slaves
description: According to Romans 6:22, we have been set free from sin to become slaves of God. If you are a genuine servant, you will serve. There must be clear behavioural marks that shows you’re a genuine slave of Christ. To obey the law of God, it takes the spirit, the love and obedience of a slave.

title: Christ In Me - Christ Revealed In Me
description: We must desire to know Christ by revelation. For no man can teach us Christ, he must be revealed via the Holy Spirit. When Christ is uncovered in our lives he will always point us towards the church. It is the Christ in each of us that forms the gloriously heterogeneous church. It is important we understand the meaning of being redeemed by Christ and his purpose for redeeming us.

title: Christ In Me - The Law Of God
description: When it comes to dealing with God, we must be righteous. We as human beings are not righteous, but Christ lived a righteous life that we might partake of it. Christ was able to pay for our debt of sins and remove the amenity with God. Everything that came from God points to Christ, including the law of God.  Everything done by the prophets pointed to Christ and his righteousness, including the law. The law of God shows us that there is another means to be righteous before God, aside from the law itself.

title: How To Make Your Faith Work
description: In the scriptures, all of those who received from Jesus had living faith. Faith is the full cycle of belief. If you believe, there will be corresponding works that follow. Faith comes by hearing, works by speaking and lives through actions. If faith works, then your faith must work and you must know how to work it.

title: Save Us From This Generation, O Lord
description: The Christ rejecting generation is an evil generation. The death of Christ saves us from eternal damnation and His life saves us from a wicked generation. If you want a brand new world, you need people with a renewed heart. Jesus is the only one who can change our hearts from the inside out.

title: The Way - Wholesome Words
description: The Word of God is primarily and fundamentally for feeding; to nourish the spirit of man and nourish our walk in God. The Word of God taught in its purity is sound doctrine, healthy words and wholesome teachings. These wholesome words make you do well in God. They strip you of self and help generate godliness in you. As you expose yourself to wholesome words you, should be able to communicate wholesome words and keep Satan at bay.

title: Enter God's Rest
description: Enter God's Rest

title: When God Gives Up On... Pt 1
description: God can give up on you, on a nation and on a generation. The wrath of God can come from, eternal wrath, end time wrath, cataclysmic wrath, consequential wrath and the foresaken wrath of God. The foresaken wrath of God is when God completely gives up on you.

title: The Impossible Can Be Possible
description: What men can’t do for you, it doesn’t mean it can’t be done, for with God everything changes. The impossible can be possible with God. To experience the possible with God every Believer must learn how to engage their spirit.

title: Standing By Faith
description: One of the things that is necessary for you as a believer, for you to thrive and see what God can do for you, is your faith. It is your faith that determines what God can do for you, because the just shall live by faith. If you want to operate in blessing, then your believing matters, even if you haven’t necessarily seen. You must stand by faith.

title: How To Grow Your Faith
description: Faith that is not developed will diminish; you must always develop your faith. Believers who are not living/walking by faith deny themselves of Heavenly results. If you want to enjoy the grace of God, faith must be engaged.

title: The Love Of God
description: Your love for God is crucial for what God can do for you and is fundamental for how far you can go in God. Love is the foundation of our Christian walk, even for your faith to work it requires love. Believers must make themselves a God-lover. Genuine love comes with, love for His Word, delightful obedience and love for His House.

title: Sowing Seeds
description: The kingdom is about seeds. The gospel is the seed, the seed that births you into the kingdom - the church is the kingdom. Sowing seeds is going out to different cities preaching the gospel. The moment you stop sowing seeds, you block the kingdom of God. Every Believer must have the mindset of sowing seeds. The word of God is a seed, nobody can be born again without a seed being sown

title: How To Win Against Sin
description: The sin problem is a struggle for every believer. As believers we have the duty to not allow sin to reign over us, nor allow it to come near us. Committing to practical steps can help us to win against sin; Take your sin seriously, strongly purpose and promise God not to sin, watch carefully for your own spiritual weakness, resist the first rising of the flesh and its pleasures, mediate on God’s word, repent immediately, continue in prayer and dependence on God’s power and establish relationship with other believers who will hold you accountable.

***** Question Time With Rev Dr David Antwi ******

Have you wandered why some people perish as a results of lack of knowledge?, Rev Awo Antwi  continues to answer Bible related questions in this episode.
